definitions.explanation: The present time, especially when contrasted with the past. A formal expression used to introduce current trends, situations, or changes in society.

examples.japanese: {昨今|さっこん}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{物価|ぶっか}→物価：03607_bukka⟧{高|だか}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{深刻|しんこく}→深刻：01567_shinkoku⟧だ。
examples.english: The recent rise in prices is serious.

examples.japanese: {昨今|さっこん}、⟦{転職|てんしょく}→転職：04557_tenshoku⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧⟦{若者|わかもの}→若者：03037_wakamono⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{増|ふ}えている→増える：01183_fueru⟧。
examples.english: Nowadays, more and more young people are changing jobs.

examples.japanese: {昨今|さっこん}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{技術|ぎじゅつ}{革新|かくしん}→技術革新：12892_gijutsukakushin⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{目覚|めざ}ましく→目覚ましい：13628_mezamashii⟧、⟦{生活|せいかつ}→生活：01443_seikatsu⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦あらゆる→あらゆる：03824_arayuru⟧⟦{面|めん}→面：09933_men⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{影響|えいきょう}→影響：01877_eikyou⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{与|あた}えている→与える：01821_ataeru⟧。
examples.english: Recent technological innovation has been remarkable, affecting every aspect of daily life.

notes:
USAGE:
A formal, written-register word. Used in news articles, essays, and formal speech to discuss current trends or social changes. More literary than ⟦{最近|さいきん}→最近：00881_saikin⟧ (recently) or このごろ (these days). Often appears at the beginning of a sentence to set the temporal frame.

COMMON PATTERNS:
- {昨今|さっこん}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧ + noun: recent/current + noun
- {昨今|さっこん}、… : nowadays, …

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {昨今|さっこん}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{情勢|じょうせい}→情勢：12739_jousei⟧: the current situation
- {昨今|さっこん}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{事情|じじょう}→事情：03272_jijou⟧: recent circumstances
- {昨今|さっこん}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{傾向|けいこう}→傾向：02695_keikou⟧: recent trends

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{最近|さいきん}→最近：00881_saikin⟧: recently (general, everyday)
- このごろ: these days (casual)
- ⟦{近年|きんねん}→近年：14349_kinnen⟧: in recent years (formal, longer timeframe)
